thesis: Qualys sells cloud vulnerability and risk management (subscription). Q3 2026 revenue 188.0M (+10.7%), GAAP operating income 66.3M (35% margin), net income 57.2M, OCF 101.8M; 9M revenue 545.9M (+10.5%), net income 160.2M (+10.4%), OCF 256.7M, capex 7.2M. No debt; cash and marketable securities 808.0M (cash 357.2M, short-term 163.6M, long-term 287.3M); total liabilities 536.3M, mostly deferred revenue 426.4M. Guidance raised 2026-11-09 (revenue 736.9-738.9M, GAAP EPS 6.08-6.15; non-GAAP 8.07-8.14 issuer-defined). At the last two-source verified close 190.41 (2026-11-06) and 34.909M shares (2026-10-23): market cap 6.65B, 31.2x TTM GAAP net income (213.4M), TTM FCF 324.4M = 4.9% yield (3.7% after TTM stock comp of 79.0M), EV about 5.84B. Price fell from 224.12 (10-30) to 190.41 (11-06), -15%; cause not confirmed. 11-09 close 202.85 (stockanalysis; Yahoo header 202.46) preceded the release, so the post-earnings reaction is unknown.
counterthesis: Growth is only about 10% and decelerating (Q4 guide 9-10%); 31x GAAP earnings and 4.9% FCF yield is not cheap for that growth. Direct channel revenue is flat (9M +0.3%); all growth is from partners (+21%), which may carry lower margins. Share count is falling only because of 185.6M of buybacks in 9M that exceed free cash flow less option proceeds; option exercise proceeds of 65.6M inflated 9M financing; SBC is 10.7% of 9M revenue; operating cash flow benefits from deferred revenue and receivable timing (+30.6M working capital). Competition from larger platforms (security suites) and AI-driven disruption of scanner products; accounts receivable and billings timing. Non-GAAP guidance excludes SBC. Peer and own-history multiples not computed.
invalidation: Revenue growth falling below high single digits, partner channel margin compression or direct-revenue declines, rising churn or lower net revenue retention, SBC dilution outpacing buybacks, or loss of large-customer share to platform vendors.
